title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ（中田修平研究室）
subtitle: Design Project III(Nakata Shuhei)
teachers:
NAKATA Shuhei
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal:
(1)	Students will learn the power semiconductor and power electronics.
(2)	Students will learn circuit simulation techniques to analyze the power converter system.
(3)	Students will learn how to evaluate the power semiconductor and estimate the safety operation area of the power semiconductor.
advice:
Class overview and management
 Under the advice of the academic advisor, research activities will be conducted on the project theme.

Project
1.	Research of the power converter
a)	High frequency operation of the several kinds of converter.
b)	Application of the SiC or GaN semiconductor for the converter.
2.	Research of the safety operation area of the power semiconductor
a)	Estimation of the ultra-fast switching stress on the characteristics of the power semiconductor
b)	Precise electric circuit modeling of the power semiconductor aiming for the ultra-fast switching operation

requiredKnowledge: Fully understanding of “Electric Circuit I, II, III”, ”Electromagnetics I,II,III”, ”Power Electronics”, ”Semiconductor Engineering”.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand the objective and the target of the project, embody the method to achieve the target.
Be able to overcome the problem during the research process by understanding the essential of the problem.
Be able to make others to understand the objectives of the project at the group discussion.
Be able to evaluate the research object by gathering the related information from other research institute.
Be able to introduce the achievement of the project to others through the discussion at group meeting.
